description: Shop your local EDEKA market from the terminal or an agent: offers, basket by text, earliest pickup slot, checkout with a confirmation gate.

novel_features.name: Basket by text
novel_features.description: Add a product by id or by plain words; the CLI picks the best match in your market and adds it.

novel_features.name: Earliest pickup slot
novel_features.description: The first free pickup slot of your market in one call.

novel_features.name: Checkout with confirmation gate
novel_features.description: Preview the order (slot, payment, items, total) and place it only with --confirm.

novel_features.name: Shopping list to basket
novel_features.description: Add many free-text lines with quantities at once and see what matched.

novel_features.name: Offer check for staples
novel_features.description: Which of these items are on offer in your market this week.

novel_features.name: Price history
novel_features.description: Prices an article had over time in your markets, from your own searches and offer lookups.

novel_features.name: Compare markets
novel_features.description: The same search on several EDEKA markets side by side.
